pass_a_gloss: §29 dual gloss: ἀπαρχὰς / firstfruit; λύτροις / ransom … Pass A scaffolding ≠ Pass B continuous English. Theme: Future fuller praise; priest firstfruits and sin-portions; redemption
pass_b_english: Cyril: …to those in bonds, Come out, and to those in the dark, Be uncovered;’ the same manner, I think, with death having been abolished, and sin having been loosed altogether, there will be a manner of praise fitting the time; for upon greater things we will hymn; and having grown rich the goods beyond mind and word, with brighter well-speakings we will crown-together Christ the giver of all the goods for us with God and Father. ‘For whether prophecies will be abolished,’ he says, ‘or knowledge will cease; And now at least we know from part; but whenever the perfect should come, the from part will be abolished.’ And indeed also Christ himself somewhere said: ‘These things in parables I have spoken to you. But an hour comes when neither in parables will I speak to you, but with frankness concerning the Father I will announce to you.’ So then with more perfect knowledge about to be in us according to times, higher than now we will also hymn.

Cyril: So then having legislated for each sacrifice the bound fitting it, and having said very well how it would become, at once he sets the sacred-worker as partner of the altar. For it has been written thus: ‘And the Lord said toward Aaron, saying: You and your sons, and the house of your patriarchy, will take the firstfruits of the holy things; and you and your sons will take the sins of your priesthood.’ And having added to these that they must hold the sacred zeals with awakened and sober mind, ‘And behold I,’ he says, ‘have given you the keeping of the firstfruits from all the things sanctified to me from the sons of Israel; to you I have given them unto a prize, and to your sons after you, eternal lawful; and let this be for you from the sanctified holy of the fruitings, from all their gifts, and from all their sacrificings, and from every trespass of them, and from all their sins, as many as they give back to me from all the holy things, for you will be and for your sons. In the Holy of holies you will eat them; every male will eat them, you and your sons. Holy they will be for you. And this will be for you of firstfruits of their gifts, from all the puttings-on of the sons of Israel. To you I have given them and to your sons and to your daughters with you, eternal lawful; every clean one in your house will eat them. Every firstfruit of oil, and every firstfruit of wine, and of grain, their firstfruit as many as they should give to the Lord, to you I have given them. All the first-borns as many as in their land, as many as they should bring to Lord, for you will be. Every clean one in your house will eat them. Every having been anathematized in sons of Israel, for you will be, and every opening womb from every flesh, as many as they offer to Lord, from human until beast, for you will be. But either by ransoms the firstborn of humans will be ransomed, and the firstborn of the unclean beasts you will ransom; and his ransom, from a month-old; the valuation five shekels, according to the holy shekel, twenty obols they are; except firstborn
